chat_message.description: a message said in a room of a chat platform, its words in `doc{body}`
one message said in a room of a chat platform; its words are `doc{body}`. Its eid is derived from `via` and `message_id` (@yaks/chat `messageEid`), so hearing it twice writes one

via.description: the chat platform it was said on, by its plugin's name

reply_to.description: the platform's id for the message it answers, where it answers one

mentioned.description: whether it named the bot that heard it, or was said to it alone

chat_room.description: a place messages are said on a chat platform: a Discord or Slack channel, a direct conversation, a Telegram chat. Its eid is derived from `via` and `id` (`roomEid`)

via.description: the chat platform, by its plugin's name

server.description: the platform's id for the server or workspace it belongs to; none for a direct conversation

name.description: what the platform calls it, where it says

chat_account.description: someone on a chat platform. Which person here they are is said by that person's connection to the platform's sign-in, whose account is `id`, never on this row. Its eid is derived from `via` and `id` (`accountEid`)

via.description: the chat platform, by its plugin's name

name.description: the name they go by there
